decisions.briefing: Market was neutral today (NASDAQ -0.9%, S&P 500 -0.7%) with no strong risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($489.29) is below the $500 deployment threshold, and per past lessons we don't force buys on neutral days just to fill open slots, so we held all 7 positions unchanged.

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices pulled back modestly today, with the NASDAQ down 0.9% and the S&P 500 down 0.7%, reflecting a broad, low-conviction risk-off tilt rather than any single catalyst. Momentum candidates on the screener still showed bullish setups, but with cash below the buy threshold there was no reason to chase names into a soft tape. Holding steady through mild pullbacks like this protects existing gains while avoiding whipsaw trades.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日美股主要指數普遍回落,納指下跌0.9%,標普500下跌0.7%,屬於缺乏明確催化劑的溫和risk-off格局。雖然篩選名單中仍有多隻股票呈現技術面偏多訊號,但由於現金水位低於加碼門檻,今日不宜追高進場。在這類溫和回調中按兵不動,有助保住現有獲利,同時避免因追漲殺跌而增加交易成本。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Cash discipline means not forcing a trade just because you have open slots or feel pressure to "do something." On a neutral day with cash below your deployment threshold, the disciplined move is to wait for a genuine risk-on signal rather than buying into a soft market.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 現金紀律是指不會因為有空餘倉位或急於「做點什麼」而勉強交易。在市場中性、現金水位又未達加碼門檻的日子,有紀律的做法是耐心等待真正的risk-on訊號出現,而不是在疲弱市況中勉強進場。
